{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp (run)
import Network.Wai (Application, responseLBS)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (status302, status200, status400)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Header (hLocation, hContentType)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.IORef
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newEmptyMVar, putMVar, takeMVar)
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import System.Posix.Signals
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Network.URI (parseURI, uriAuthority, uriRegName, URI(..))

-- Application configuration
data AppConfig = AppConfig
  { appPort :: Int
  , appAllowedHosts :: [Text]
  , appBaseUrl :: Text
  , appShutdownRef :: IORef Bool
  }

-- Allowed redirect domains for security
allowedDomains :: [Text]
allowedDomains = ["example.com", "app.example.com", "cdn.example.com"]

-- Normalize a URL for consistent comparison
normalizeUrl :: Text -> Text
normalizeUrl url = 
  let stripped = T.strip url
      -- Remove any null bytes or control characters
      cleaned = T.filter (\c -> c > '\x1f' && c /= '\x7f') stripped
      -- Normalize scheme to lowercase
      normalized = if T.isPrefixOf "HTTP://" (T.toUpper cleaned)
                   then T.append "http://" (T.drop 7 cleaned)
                   else if T.isPrefixOf "HTTPS://" (T.toUpper cleaned)
                   then T.append "https://" (T.drop 8 cleaned)
                   else cleaned
  in normalized

-- Extract the host from a URL
extractHost :: Text -> Maybe Text
extractHost url = 
  let normalized = normalizeUrl url
      str = T.unpack normalized
  in case parseURI str of
       Just uri -> case uriAuthority uri of
         Just auth -> Just $ T.pack (uriRegName auth)
         Nothing -> Nothing
       Nothing -> Nothing

-- Validate that a redirect target is safe
-- Returns True if the URL is a relative path or points to an allowed domain
validateRedirectTarget :: [Text] -> Text -> Bool
validateRedirectTarget allowed url =
  let normalized = normalizeUrl url
  in if isRelativePath normalized
     then True
     else case extractHost normalized of
            Just host -> any (\d -> host == d || T.isSuffixOf ("." <> d) host) allowed
            Nothing -> isRelativePath normalized

-- Check if a URL is a relative path (safe for redirect)
isRelativePath :: Text -> Bool
isRelativePath url =
  let t = T.stripStart url
  in T.isPrefixOf "/" t && not (T.isPrefixOf "//" t)

-- Build the redirect URL, handling the case where the target
-- might need to be combined with a return-to parameter
buildRedirectUrl :: Text -> Maybe Text -> Text
buildRedirectUrl target maybeReturnTo =
  case maybeReturnTo of
    Nothing -> target
    Just returnTo -> 
      -- If there's a returnTo, we append it as a query parameter
      -- to the target so the destination knows where to send the user next
      let separator = if T.isInfixOf "?" target then "&" else "?"
      in target <> separator <> "next=" <> returnTo

-- Graceful shutdown handler
setupGracefulShutdown :: IORef Bool -> MVar () -> IO ()
setupGracefulShutdown shutdownRef shutdownMVar = do
  let handler = do
        writeIORef shutdownRef True
        putMVar shutdownMVar ()
  installHandler sigTERM (Catch handler) Nothing
  installHandler sigINT (Catch handler) Nothing
  return ()

main :: IO ()
main = do
  shutdownRef <- newIORef False
  shutdownMVar <- newEmptyMVar
  
  let config = AppConfig
        { appPort = 8080
        , appAllowedHosts = allowedDomains
        , appBaseUrl = "https://example.com"
        , appShutdownRef = shutdownRef
        }
  
  setupGracefulShutdown shutdownRef shutdownMVar
  
  -- Start the web server in a separate thread
  _ <- forkIO $ scotty (appPort config) $ do
    
    -- Health check endpoint
    get "/health" $ do
      isShuttingDown <- liftIO $ readIORef (appShutdownRef config)
      if isShuttingDown
        then status status400 >> text "shutting down"
        else status status200 >> text "ok"
    
    -- Login redirect endpoint
    get "/auth/login" $ do
      maybeTarget <- queryParamMaybe "redirect_uri" :: ActionM (Maybe Text)
      maybeReturn <- queryParamMaybe "return_to" :: ActionM (Maybe Text)
      
      let target = maybe "/dashboard" id maybeTarget
      let finalUrl = buildRedirectUrl target maybeReturn
      
      -- Validate the final constructed URL
      if validateRedirectTarget (appAllowedHosts config) finalUrl
        then redirect (TL.fromStrict finalUrl)
        else status status400 >> text "Invalid redirect target"
    
    -- OAuth callback with redirect
    get "/auth/callback" $ do
      stateParam <- queryParamMaybe "state" :: ActionM (Maybe Text)
      targetParam <- queryParamMaybe "target" :: ActionM (Maybe Text)
      
      let target = maybe "/dashboard" id targetParam
      
      if validateRedirectTarget (appAllowedHosts config) target
        then redirect (TL.fromStrict target)
        else status status400 >> text "Invalid redirect target"
    
    -- Logout with redirect
    get "/auth/logout" $ do
      maybeNext <- queryParamMaybe "next" :: ActionM (Maybe Text)
      let target = maybe "/" id maybeNext
      
      if validateRedirectTarget (appAllowedHosts config) target
        then redirect (TL.fromStrict target)
        else status status400 >> text "Invalid redirect target"
  
  -- Wait for shutdown signal
  takeMVar shutdownMVar
  -- Give in-flight requests time to complete
  threadDelay 5000000
  putStrLn "Graceful shutdown complete"
